cat > /root/nlp_variance_gtheory/scripts/yi_after_olmo.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /root/nlp_variance_gtheory
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export PYTHONPATH=/root/nlp_variance_gtheory:$PYTHONPATH
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

YI_DESIGN=results/exp002/design_matrix_yi.csv
YI_DIR=results/exp002_yi
mkdir -p $YI_DIR

OLMO_PIDS="52651 52654 52657 52660"
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Waiting for OLMo PIDs: $OLMO_PIDS"
for pid in $OLMO_PIDS; do
    while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do
        sleep 30
    done
    echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] PID $pid done"
done
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] All OLMo experiments finished"

echo "OLMo results:"
wc -l $PWD/results/exp002_olmo/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null

echo ""
echo "===== Starting Yi-1.5-9B-Chat ====="

echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] --- Yi Round 1: MMLU + ARC + HellaSwag + GSM8K (4 GPUs) ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m src.inference.run_experiment \
    --design "$YI_DESIGN" --benchmark mmlu --gpu-id 0 \
    --items data/mmlu_items_exp001.json --output "$YI_DIR/exp002_yi_mmlu.jsonl" \
    > "$YI_DIR/yi_mmlu.log" 2>&1 &
P0=$!
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] mmlu GPU0 PID=$P0"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python -m src.inference.run_experiment \
    --design "$YI_DESIGN" --benchmark arc --gpu-id 0 \
    --output "$YI_DIR/exp002_yi_arc.jsonl" \
    > "$YI_DIR/yi_arc.log" 2>&1 &
P1=$!
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] arc GPU1 PID=$P1"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -m src.inference.run_experiment \
    --design "$YI_DESIGN" --benchmark hellaswag --gpu-id 0 \
    --output "$YI_DIR/exp002_yi_hellaswag.jsonl" \
    > "$YI_DIR/yi_hellaswag.log" 2>&1 &
P2=$!
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] hellaswag GPU2 PID=$P2"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python -m src.inference.run_experiment \
    --design "$YI_DESIGN" --benchmark gsm8k --gpu-id 0 \
    --output "$YI_DIR/exp002_yi_gsm8k.jsonl" \
    > "$YI_DIR/yi_gsm8k.log" 2>&1 &
P3=$!
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] gsm8k GPU3 PID=$P3"

echo "Yi Round 1 PIDs: $P0 $P1 $P2 $P3"
for pid in $P0 $P1 $P2 $P3; do
    wait $pid
    echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] PID $pid finished (exit=$?)"
done
echo "[$(date '+%H:%M:%S')] Yi Round 1 COMPLETE"

echo "--- Yi Round 2: MATH (1 GPU) ---"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -m src.inference.run_experiment \
